translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Bika kuidi beto, a Yave, bika kuidi beto ;
vayi kuidi dizina diaku kuba nkembo,
mu diambu di luzolo luaku ayi kikhuikizi kiaku.
Bila mbi makanda malembo tubila ti :
“Kuevi kuidi Nzambi awu e ?”
Nzambi eto widi ku Diyilu,
niandi weti vanga moso katidi.
Vayi bitumba biawu bidi palata ayi nolo ;
bivangulu mu mioko mi batu.
Bibeki miunu vayi bilendi yoluka ko ;
meso vayi bilendi mona ko.
Bibeki matu vayi bilendi wa ko ;
mayilu vayi bilendi wa tsudi ko.
Bibeki mioko vayi bilendi simba ko,
malu vayi bilendi diata ko.
Voti bilendi totula ko biyoko mu phovi-yi-dilaka diawu.
Batu bobo bavanga biawu bela ba banga biawu,
ayi buawu bobo buela bela batu boso bobo bantulanga diana mu biawu.
A nzo yi Iseli, tula diana mu Yave.
Niandi nsadisi awu ayi nkaku awu.
A Nzo yi Aloni, tula diana mu Yave.
Niandi nsadisi awu ayi nkaku awu.
Beno lueti kunkinzika, lutula diana mu Yave.
Niandi nsadisi awu ayi nkaku awu.
Yave weti kututebukila moyo ayi wela kutusakumuna.
Wela sakumuna nzo yi Iseli,
wela sakumuna nzo yi Aloni.
Wela sakumuna bobo beti kinzika Yave,
batu baphamba va kimosi ayi batu banneni.
Bika Yave kaluwokisa,
beno ayi bana beno va kimosi.
Bika Yave kalusakuna,
mvangi wu diyilu ayi ntoto.
Yave niandi vuidi Diyilu dizangama
vayi ntoto wuvanu kuidi mutu.
Kadi sia ti bafua bawu beti zitisa Yave ;
bobo bankuendanga ku tsi yidi dio sui.
Vayi beto tueti yayisa Yave
tona buabu nate mu zithangu zioso.
Luzitisa Yave.
